reason: Expert provides a successful troubleshooting rule involving a power cycle (cold restart) for baseband units on older base stations after a power outage when cells fail to come up.

knowledge.summary: On older base stations following a power outage, a soft reboot does not resolve a down cell; perform a cold restart of the baseband unit by turning off power completely, waiting 30 seconds, and powering it back on.
knowledge.author: Sanna Siirto
knowledge.details: Power off completely, wait 30 seconds, and power back on.
